summary: ORIX Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting the potential impact of Toshiba's full-year financial results on ORIX's consolidated results for the first quarter of fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. Toshiba recorded a large income item related to Kioxia Holdings, and ORIX indirectly holds Toshiba shares through an equity-method affiliate, TB Investment Limited Partnership. No transaction, tender, activist campaign, or strategic review is announced. This is a routine earnings-related disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
